ai_summary: The Andhra Sugars Limited reported a substantial increase in unaudited net profit for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, primarily driven by improved selling prices in its Chlor-Alkali and Industrial Chemicals segments, which saw significant quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year profit growth. While the Sugar segment continues to incur losses, overall revenue and profitability are robust. As these are unaudited results subject to a limited review, investors should note the inherent level of assurance.
